description: 50% Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme of Sri Lanka Tea Board for 'Ceylon Tea' Exporters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Tea Board has been implementing the 50% Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme for Sri Lankan Tea Exporters since 2015 to facilitate Sri Lankan tea exporters to find new international buyers and promote their 'Ceylon Tea' brands globally. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantations and Community Infrastructure to continue the said Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.
